content: This document provides a summary of information about the product but does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice and should not replace consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your individual health requirements. Precautions: Before using aluminum hydroxide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It may also pass into breast milk, so consult your doctor before breastfeeding. Drug interactions can alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Note that antacids can interfere with the absorption of many other medications. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Lifestyle Changes: Certain lifestyle modifications may enhance the effectiveness of this medication. These include stress reduction programs, quitting smoking, limiting alcohol consumption, and making dietary changes such as avoiding caffeine, fatty foods, and specific spices. Missed Dose: If you are taking this product on a regular schedule and miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this product at room temperature. It may also be refrigerated to improve taste, but do not freeze it. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in May 2024. Always use this information as a general guide and consult your healthcare professional for personalized advice.
